description: A worked example of TeamPushData.content: AES-256-GCM under the device's pushKey with additional data "<deviceId>:<keyVersion>" (UTF-8), sealed as base64url without padding of nonce (12 bytes) | ciphertext | tag (16 bytes). Encrypting vector.plaintext (exact UTF-8 bytes) with vector.key, vector.nonce and vector.aad gives vector.content; decrypting vector.content gives vector.plaintext, which decodes to valid[0].value. Any other additional data (another device or key version) must fail to decrypt. The Go server encrypts and the iOS team app decrypts this same vector.
